blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Djed is a Cardano native asset. Cardano's native-token model routes ordinary transfers through the ledger rather than an ERC-20-style token contract; the minting policy controls mint and burn operations, not arbitrary holder transfers. The official Djed documentation and technical review describe the ADA reserve, DJED mint/burn, and SHEN mechanisms without a holder blacklist or freeze path. Direct holder-balance blacklistability remains false.

oracleRisk.summary: COTI documents Djed's production oracle as one aggregator drawing from at least six external market sources. An exchange-rate update is accepted only when at least three sources are available; otherwise no update occurs. That shared ADA/USD rate governs system-wide mint, redemption, and reserve-ratio accounting rather than borrower liquidations.

branchApplicability.rationale: Djed has one shared ADA reserve and no borrower-specific collateral positions or liquidations. Its aggregated ADA/USD exchange rate prices protocol-wide DJED/SHEN mint and redemption and the 400%-800% reserve gates, so that complete price-sensitive path belongs at top level.
